concerns.text: User Story 1 (Data Ingestion and Preprocessing) has functional requirements (FR-001, FR-002) but no success criteria are anchored to it; SC-001‑SC-005 do not reference US‑1.
Success Criterion SC-005 (runtime measurement) is not linked to any user story; it lacks an anchor such as ‘(See US‑2)’ and therefore is an orphaned SC.
